name: hcapp_deleteChatMessage
description: Deletes one chat message (run, kennel or room) for everyone: the caller's own, or anyone's if they moderate the thread (moderateChat in the kennel; SuperAdmin for rooms). Soft delete via HC6.nonApi_deleteChatMessage. Idempotent. E9.F1.S13/S14.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail alone.
After a 0 envelope: 1980 missing id, 1981 not found, 1982 not allowed (errorType 3), 1983 unhandled (5).

sideEffects: trgEventMessageActivityCount refreshes the run card's chat count
LOG.GeneralLog line with the removed text when a moderator removes someone else's message
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
